The final legacy formula remains a Career Mode 2.0 policy layer above the proven retail evidence inputs.

0x00..0x15.limitation: The retail history entry stores the displayed opponent string, not a proven stable progression-record ID or opponent rank-at-fight.

0x18.confidence: CONFIRMED UI role; exact unit/encoding pending formatter decode
evidence: Reader copies entry+0x18 to the UI temporary record.
GetCareerHistoryInfo tests the byte for >0, passes it to formatter 0x00206E18 and emits the formatted string through astrTKOTime; zero uses the fallback placeholder.

retail_fight_history.class_mapping: profile+0x121 values 0/1 write class 0 (Amateur); values >1 write class 1 (Professional)
legacy_consequence: Retail preserves at most the most recent 20 amateur and 20 professional bouts.
The entry is sufficient for displayed opponent/result/rounds/TKO-time history.

It is not sufficient by itself for robust Career 2.0 opposition-quality scoring because no stable opponent ID, opponent rank-at-fight, division-at-fight or title-stakes field is proven in the 25-byte entry.
Career Mode 2.0 therefore needs a mod-owned persistent legacy fight ledger if opposition quality and multi-division accomplishments must remain exact across a full career.
